searches_run: WebSearch: Nancy Vaughan Greensboro mayor 2015 campaign website (refused, budget used up)
DuckDuckGo html via mac2 (returned no result links)
note: WebSearch budget was used up. DuckDuckGo and Bing through mac2 gave no useful results. Ballotpedia and Wikipedia pages gave no campaign website. The old URL nancyvaughan.net has no capture of any date in the CDX index (host and prefix queries, with and without www). Guessed domains with no capture: nancyvaughan.com, nancyvaughan.org, nancyvaughanformayor.com, vaughanformayor.com, vaughan4mayor.com, nancyvaughanmayor.com, nancyvaughan4greensboro.com. The queries for nancyformayor.com, voteforvaughan.com, nancyvaughan4mayor.com, electnancyvaughan.com and nancyvaughan2015.com ran in a background job that was never confirmed. One query (nancyforgreensboro.com) returned an Internet Archive Temporarily Offline page. No search found the real site, so the result is incomplete, not not_found.
